analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold and is now ranging in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. Despite 5 consecutive daily closes in the green, the price failed to reclaim the 20-day moving average ($284.19) and is facing resistance. No clear trend reversal signal confirmed, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
